_comment: Judgement input for scripts/synthesise.py. The model writes this after reading the seven reviewer files; the script does everything mechanical. Only 'groups' and 'application' are required. Delete keys you do not use.
_severity_context: Facts that resolve conditional rubric severities ('Blocker (internet-facing or T1)', 'Major; Blocker for critical providers'). Tier, change type, regimes in scope and prior-review regressions are taken from the fields above and from --prior; these are the ones the script cannot derive. Omit a flag you cannot evidence: the condition is then left unresolved and the run warns, which is the honest outcome.
summary: Two or three sentences for the business owner: what the design gets right, then the reason for the verdict.
_commitments: Who has committed to fix what, by when. Keyed by rule ID or by finding ID; a rule ID survives renumbering across re-reviews, so prefer it. A Major with no owner and no date is not a condition the board can hold anyone to, so the verdict is held at 'Insufficient information' until every live Major has both. Reviewers supply the owning role; the date comes from the team.

groups.title: Optional override of the primary finding's title
groups.severity: Optional: one level up or down from the computed severity

fix_before_board.action: State the DR pattern and timed recovery sequence

pre_read_note: One sentence on which mandatory intake artefacts are missing.

board_questions.q: Your RTO is 15 minutes. Walk me through the 15 minutes.

board.summary: One paragraph for non-engineers. Defaults to 'summary' above.

limitations_extra: Any assumption to verify, e.g. vendor support statements taken from general knowledge.
